targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(${group_by}) as grouping, count() AS "Total Requests", ${time_agg} as min
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY min, grouping
ORDER BY grouping, min ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Requests; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN ${duration} <= 1 THEN 'toStartOfMinute(${timestamp})'
        WHEN ${duration} <= 6 THEN 'toStartOfFiveMinutes(${timestamp})'
        WHEN ${duration} <= 24 THEN 'toStartOfFifteenMinutes(${timestamp})'
        ELSE 'toStartOfHour(${timestamp})'
    END
